title: Ergast Race Result Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ergast:result
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by constructor
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Ergast race result data has stopped arriving for a given constructor.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per constructor and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures when one part of your Ergast race result feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
